summary: Prompt G (Toggl-style time tracking) end-to-end tested. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed (auth guard, 13 categories, client+engagement CRUD, subject validation 400s, timer start/stop, auto-stop previous, summary, hours-week, students coach_minutes). Frontend: TimerBar visible on admin layout only (not on public pages), Clients create + engagement add works, client timer start/stop with search+pick works, Time page summary cards + 4 tabs + delete works, Students page shows Coach time column. Found and fixed one minor data-testid bug on AdminDashboard where 'Hours this week' resulted in 'stat-hours-this week' (space) instead of 'stat-hours-this-week' due to .replace(' ', '-') replacing only first space.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for Hours-this-week card was 'stat-hours-this week' (unreplaced space) because String.prototype.replace replaces only first occurrence. Fixed to /g regex.

action_items: No blocking issues. One trivial data-testid bug on dashboard auto-fixed by tester (replaceAll space-to-dash).
critical_code_review_comments: timetrack.py update_client/update_engagement return raw mongo doc without excluding _id in the find_one after update — risk of ObjectId serialization. Confirmed: find_one is called without projection {"_id":0} on lines 88 and 104. Low risk because docs were inserted via insert_one but motor adds _id. Suggest adding NO_ID projection.
AdminTime.jsx useEffect for 'time-updated' event has no dependency array ([]) — handler re-registers every render; minor perf nit.
TimerBar client-search uses GET /admin/clients (no server-side search param) and client-filters — fine at small scale, consider adding ?q= to API.
No DELETE endpoint for coaching_clients — TEST_ clients accumulate; tests cannot fully clean up.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created TEST_Alice client + quantum-leap engagement + several time entries; entries were deleted in cleanup test. Client remains (no DELETE endpoint). UITest Client was created via UI and one timer entry was deleted during UI run; UITest client remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prompt G verified. No DELETE endpoint exists for coaching_clients so test clients named 'TEST_Alice Zhao' and 'UITest Client' remain in the DB — safe to ignore or manually clean. Deferred features (week-grid view, CSV export) were intentionally not implemented per original problem statement.
rca of the issue: Dashboard testid bug: JavaScript String.prototype.replace with a plain string replaces only the first occurrence. The label 'Hours this week' contains two spaces so .replace(' ', '-') produced 'hours-this week'. Fix: use /g regex: .replace(/ /g, '-'). Applied.
